description: Department of Local Government - Southern Province - Order given by the Hon. Chairman of Tangalle Municipal Council to be amended
reasoning: This gazette content describes an amendment to financial management orders for the Urban Council of Tangalle, specifically restricting expenditure to recurring expenses and requiring council approval for capital expenditures. It involves structural/administrative changes to how a government body (Urban Council) operates, referencing legal authorities (Urban Council Ordinance, Provincial Councils Act). While it names the Governor and Chairman, these are mentioned only in their official capacities as authorizing and receiving the order, not as personnel changes. The core content is about administrative procedures and financial management rules for a government body, fitting Type 1 (Organisational Gazette).
